name: Club for Growth Foundation
notes: Club for Growth Foundation 2025 Congressional Economic Scorecard: Economic Growth Score from 0 to 100 based on votes on economic legislation. score is the 2025 annual score; lifetime is the Foundation's lifetime score. Collected from the interactive scorecard app list pages (chamber, party and state filters), which show every member at once; the page text is capped near 140k characters so House was read in pieces (R and D sorted by state, then per state for later states: NY OH OR PA RI SC SD TN TX UT VA VT WA WI WV WY). Matched by bioguide ID taken from each row's legislator link, then checked against roster chamber, state, district and last name. Gaps: 14 roster members have score null and lifetime null because they are not on the 2025 scorecard: 6 non-voting delegates (DC, VI, AS, GU, MP, PR; state=PR and DC pages return no rows) and 8 members who took office after 2025 or are replacements (Menefee TX-18, Fuller GA-14, Mejia NJ-11, Gallagher CA-1, Blair GA-13, Wahab CA-14, and senators Armstrong OK and Darline Graham SC). Menendez NJ-8 (roster M001226) is listed by the site under the bioguide ID M000639 with district 08, scores 16 and lifetime 7, matched by state, district and name. Where the site shows n.a. the value is null (3 more members, so 522 of 539 have scores): Adelita Grijalva AZ-7 (both), Van Epps TN-7 (both), Walkinshaw VA-11 (both). Site rows for departed members (Lindsey Graham, Marjorie Taylor Greene, Mark Green, Raul Grijalva, Connolly, Sylvester Turner, Swalwell, Sherrill etc.) were ignored if not in the roster. Scores are published as percent numbers, no letter grades.
